## After the Stations

### Form Your Project Groups

By the end of the session, form groups of **3-4 students**.

Your group will:
- Work together on the group research project
- Conduct labs together from Week 16
- Generate data for the Research Report (Week 22)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Tips for Group Formation
- Choose people you can reliably meet with outside class
- Consider different strengths (organisation, analysis, writing)
- Exchange contact details before leaving
:::

### Register Your Group

Once formed, register your group: **[Link TBC]**
